Streams a multipart archive to a temporary file, then verifies platform target, resource budget, sample inference and config schema before registering the algorithm. Rejects platform mismatch, unsupported archive formats, zip-slip paths, decompression bombs, invalid manifest tokens and already installed versions.

delete.description: Removes the algorithm registration and its installed files. Deleting an algorithm that is currently ACTIVE returns 409 ALGORITHM_IS_ACTIVE; disable it first.

get.description: Returns how many tasks, cameras and evidence records reference this algorithm. Read-only: it has no side effects and can be called freely before asking the operator to confirm. Note that deleting an algorithm does NOT delete evidence records — it only clears their algorithm reference, so `algorithmId` becomes empty while the `algorithmName` / `algorithmVersion` snapshots remain.
get.summary: Preview the impact of deleting an algorithm

post.description: Stops the supervised runner subprocess and sets the algorithm status to DISABLED.
post.summary: Disable an algorithm and stop its runner process

post.description: Starts the supervised runner subprocess and sets the algorithm status to ACTIVE. The runner is monitored and restarted according to the recovery policy until the crash-loop threshold is reached.
post.summary: Enable an algorithm and start its runner process

post.description: Clears the crash-loop circuit breaker and returns the algorithm to DISABLED so it can be enabled again. Returns 409 ALGORITHM_NOT_IN_CRASH_LOOP when the algorithm is not currently in CRASH_LOOP.
post.summary: Reset an algorithm stuck in CRASH_LOOP

post.description: Performs a one-shot inference using an uploaded static image against an installed, disabled algorithm. Returns structured detection/classification/structure results with bounding boxes and execution duration.
post.summary: Run trial inference with a static image

get.description: List active API tokens (and optionally revoked tokens).

post.description: Create a new API token. The plaintext token is returned only once.

delete.description: Soft-delete an API token by ID. Revoked tokens immediately stop working.

首个文本帧为 audio_info；随后为 20 字节 ZLA1 头 + 裸负载的二进制帧。
同一登录会话只允许一条：新连接以 4001 接管旧的；全局上限 8 条（4002）；
无音轨时先发 error 文本帧再以 4404 关闭；队列溢出以 4003 关闭。

get.description: Returns the persisted GB28181 target configuration plus the configuration the running process actually loaded, its state and whether a restart is required.

put.description: Validates and atomically persists the GB28181 configuration. The running SIP listener is not reconfigured; the response reports restartRequired until the process is restarted. An empty mediaAdvertisedIp opts into single-address inference and assumes no NAT; NAT deployments must provide an explicit reachable address.

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED, GB28181_CONFIG_INVALID, GB28181_PORT_RANGE_INVALID, GB28181_ADDRESS_UNRESOLVABLE, GB28181_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED, GB28181_REGISTERED_DEVICE_REQUIRED

get.description: Returns the device allowlist with online state. Digest passwords are never included.

put.description: Adds a device to the registration allowlist or updates its metadata and Digest password. Omitting password keeps the stored credential. The password is encrypted before storage and is never returned.
put.summary: Provision or update a GB28181 device

delete.description: Deletes a pre-provisioned GB28181 device. If any of its channels are bound to a camera, deletion is rejected until the camera is unbound or deleted.

post.description: Sends a SIP Catalog query to an online GB28181 device, reassembles the channel fragments, and reconciles the local catalog: channels the device no longer reports are removed unless a camera is still bound to them.

get.description: Returns all imported video channels for a GB28181 device.

post.description: Creates a camera entity from an imported GB28181 channel, bypassing RTSP probe gates and assigning protocol gb28181.

get.description: Reports live counters for operators: device totals, active sessions, media port pool usage, exhausted-port hits and the inbound/outbound signalling protection counters.

Streams the raw bytes of a media file with full RFC 7233 range support. The server performs byte transfer only: no decoding, demuxing, remuxing, transcoding or slicing. The successful response body is a raw byte stream, not the JSON envelope; error responses follow the standard envelope except for 416, which net/http writes as plain text.

affectedCameraIds.description: AffectedCameraIDs 列出受影响相机，供前端直接展示「这 3 台相机会停」。

boundTaskCount.description:
BoundTaskCount 是当前绑定了该算法的通道任务数。卸载后这些任务的该算法条目
会被删除；任务本身保留（其他算法不受影响），但若某任务因此变成空任务，
那台相机就完全停止分析了。

recognitionCount.description:
RecognitionCount / AlarmCount / CaptureCount 是历史证据条数。
卸载**不会删除**它们，只会让 algorithm_id 变成 NULL。
前端文案必须准确：是「失去归属」而非「删除」。

requiresStop.description: RequiresStop 表示算法当前正在运行，卸载会先强制停止它。

modifiedAt.description: ModifiedAt is the file modification time in UTC (RFC3339Nano).

name.description: Name is the final path element.

path.description:
Path is the relative path inside the media root, using forward slashes
and no leading slash. This is the same value persisted by the event
domain, so it can round-trip back into the content endpoint.

sizeBytes.description: SizeBytes is the file length in bytes.

setDefault.description: Designate this interface as default gateway

ipAddresses.description: Assigned IPv4 addresses with CIDR prefix, e.g. ["192.168.1.100/24"]

isCurrent.description: True only when the request maps unambiguously to this interface

isDefaultGw.description: True if interface hosts default route (0.0.0.0/0)

personId.description:
PersonID is the external business key. It is optional: if omitted or empty,
it is left unset (NULL) without falling back to the internal primary key.

name.description:
Name is a pointer so that "not provided" (nil) stays distinguishable from
"provided": an explicitly empty name must be rejected rather than ignored.

personId.description:
PersonID is accepted only so that an attempt to change it fails loudly instead
of being silently dropped by the JSON decoder. Supplying a different value is
rejected with PERSON_ID_IMMUTABLE.

algorithmName.description: 同 RecognitionResponse：算法卸载后的来源凭证。

algorithmId.description:
与 RecognitionResponse / AlarmResponse 同构：算法卸载后 ID 变空，
名称与版本快照仍能回答「这张抓拍是哪个算法产生的」。

algorithmName.description:
AlgorithmName/Version 来自写入时快照：算法被卸载后 algorithmId 变空，
但这两个字段仍能回答「这批记录是哪个算法产生的」。

personExternalId.description:
PersonExternalID 是上报业务系统用的身份：写入时快照的 persons.person_id。
空串表示该人员当时尚未绑定业务键 —— 该条记录不可上报，不要回退成 personId。

canWrite.description: True if storage is currently accepting new writes

freeBytes.description: Available capacity for non-root users in bytes

isExternal.description: True if mounted on dedicated volume outside rootfs (/)

mountPoint.description: Mount point where the media directory lives

exportsBytes.description: Total size of temporary exported files in bytes

otherBytes.description: Other files residing on the same filesystem/volume

recordingsBytes.description: Total size of video recordings in bytes

snapshotsBytes.description: Total size of AI snapshots in bytes

autoGenerated.description:
AutoGenerated reports that the current value is the fallback this host
generated on first boot, not a name an operator chose.

algorithmId.description: Legacy single-algorithm fields for backward compatibility

crop.description: Crop 是任务级前置裁剪窗口；null 表示不裁剪。

Crop 是三态合并字段：省略=不改、null/[]/{}=清除、[x1,y1,x2,y2]=设置。

用 json.RawMessage 而不是 *region.Rect：后者无法区分“字段缺省”与“显式 null”，
而 PUT /tasks/:id 的合并语义必须区分这两者（缺省不得清空已保存的裁剪）。
